replies.name: semver
replies.body:
🤖 **Comment from Codex working with Leo:** **Decision [D021, revision 1](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/fallback-feedback.md#d021-authored-semver-controls-compatibility-delivery): authored SemVer targeting requires the SemVer delivery payload even when optimization prunes the rule.** This follows [Aaron's policy clarification](https://github.com/ddoghq/dd-source/pull/139379#discussion_r4343813531). The older-SDK preservation suggestion would make delivery depend on optimization. Overrides keep their existing exception, and unrelated flags remain available. **Implemented in [50775244](https://github.com/ddoghq/dd-source/commit/50775244ad95c65017b7890a81fde9806e330b80).** The compatibility filter now starts from the compiler's pre-optimization SemVer marker and retains its scan for decoded configurations. The current winner-classification parent is included in that signed merge. **Shared proofs:** [central draft PR #55](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/pull/55), [D021 at the published revision](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/fallback-feedback.md#d021-authored-semver-controls-compatibility-delivery), and [linked history](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/decision-history.md#d021). The shared contract remains a draft proposal, without fleet approval.
Behavior — authored targeting survives optimizer pruning | Situation | Compatibility delivery | | --- | --- | | Ordinary allocation or completed deterministic winner before SemVer | Omit flag, including when the rule is pruned | | Active experiment before SemVer | Omit flag; retain fallback in the capable payload | | Override with authored SemVer | Include override | | No SemVer | Include flag | With rollout off, non-overridden authored SemVer is omitted at compilation, as before. No tracer-version threshold or wire format changes.
Native validation — local checks at 50775244 [947 compiler, 108 Remote Config and 85 cache-worker test entries pass](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/evidence/fallback-review-20261022/native-validation.json). All 24 shared cases exercise the real compiler/filter, JSON/protobuf membership, eligible assignments, source non-mutation and unrelated flags. The [old filter fails exactly two pruning cases](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/evidence/fallback-review-20261022/native-negative-control.json). Parent integration exposed three stale fallback expectations. The corrected golden adds only two ordinary defaults; [all existing allocation data is unchanged](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/evidence/fallback-review-20261022/golden-diff.json). The existing fallback differential test checks 12,288 eligible-subject assignments. The [publication receipt](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/evidence/fallback-review-20261022/publication.json) confirms that all nine changed native files match the tested hashes and both PR commits have valid GitHub signatures. These are local test results; CI and deployment remain separate. The parent's [rollout-control concern](https://github.com/ddoghq/dd-source/pull/139368#discussion_r4354101407) remains open.
Sneak preview — reusable, checked review decisions [The Lean model](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/lean/SemverDelivery.lean) checks this theorem: ```lean theorem authored_semver_is_not_compatible (rollout : Bool) : compatibilityContains true false rollout = false := by cases rollout <;> rfl ``` An authored SemVer flag without an override never enters the abstract compatibility payload, regardless of rollout. [The same 24 corpus cases](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/corpus/semver-delivery.json) pass the Lean oracle and native compiler. [The model receipt](https://github.com/DataDog/ffe-system-test-data/blob/867d0c9f6567c1ce892f3169b4bf19cf0937c587/contracts/experimentation-opt-out/evidence/fallback-review-20261022/model-validation.json) audits 59 theorems, including six new ones, and preserves 313 existing semantic and 36 operational oracle cases. The proof covers the stated bounded model; it does not establish native optimizer equivalence, arbitrary decoder behavior, or rollout safety.
